failure_modes: Optimizing one pillar while another fails
gloss: Sleep, intake, motion, and creation as the four things to keep in order
invariants: All four pillars are attended to
mechanism: Four practical pillars form a minimal baseline for a person. Sleep comes first because without it everything fails. Intake covers food, people, and media. Motion is both emotional and physical. Creation is acting on the world. When creation turns into consumption, the other three degrade.
